text:
maya (PM): Quick thread to lock the DP cohort plan. Key question: do we prioritize 6 partners with minimal private support (doc + 2 office hours) or 3 partners with full private hook delivery (VPC + SSO + config UI)? Need a decision by EOD so Eng can scope.

ashley (Eng): 6-light sounds lower risk. Full private hook is ~2 engineers + 1 infra for ~6 weeks. If we do 3-full, that delays other infra tasks.

dan (Solutions): customers who asked for private hooks are high-touch and expect SSO and sample VPC templates. They might accept "engineer-assisted" manifests as an interim.

samir (ProdResearch): from a signal POV, more partners -> broader coverage of edge prompts. For model quality checks, we can run our evals across partner prompts iff we have telemetry and request sampling. So telemetry is non-negotiable.

zoe (Legal): quick flag: pilot addendum for private deploys needs simple data handling clause and a liability cap. I can draft a 1-page addendum if we commit to private work.

maya (PM): ok propose split plan: primary path = 6 partners, minimal private support (docs + 2 onboarding sessions + temporary engineer access for debugging). Contingency path = 3 partners with full private hooks. Acceptance gates for primary path: 
- 6 partners signed & intake completed
- telemetry hook enabled: request_id + sample_payload + response_hashing
- onboarding completion: each partner runs a smoke request within 5 business days
- quality: no more than 2 high-severity generation regressions in pilot window

ashley (Eng): telemetry hook = small SDK + server-side flag; estimate 1 sprint. Smoke request guarantee requires prefix-KV caching warmed for common prompts. We can provide cache warm script.

dan (Solutions): onboarding script idea: Day 0 - credentials and manifest; Day 2 - smoke run + troubleshooting; Day 7 - feedback interview. I can own creating the script and runbooks.

samir (ProdResearch): measurement plan: 
```
DP Metric Plan v1
- Onboard time (days): target <=5
- Active requests/week per partner: target >=100
- Eval regressions detected: target <=2
- Partner satisfaction (0-10): target >=7 avg
```

maya (PM): billing question for pilot: credits vs invoice? We want low friction.

billing-bot: Suggestion: allocate a fixed credit pool per partner (e.g., 500k tokens) and disable billing for trial resources. Track usage in console.

zoe (Legal): pilots offering free compute still need a short terms addendum, i'll push a template.

maya (PM): operational fallback if private work slips: trigger reduce-to-3-partners + communicate delay to impacted partners with options. Also add a soft SLA for support response (within 24h P0 ack).

ashley (Eng): implementation notes: if we do 6-light, infra work = telemetry + temporary role provisioning + cache script (1 sprint). If 3-full, infra = +VPC workflow + UI pages (3-4 sprints). We should call this out in the DP invite so partners choose which track.

dan (Solutions): agree. I'll add a checkbox in intake form "I need private deploy (SSO/VPC)" and rank urgency. Helps prioritize.

samir (ProdResearch): add qualitative check-ins: 3 interviews per partner: onboarding, midpoint, post-pilot. We'll store notes in doc and extract themes.

maya (PM): action items: Dan -> onboarding script + intake checkbox by Thu. Ashley -> telemetry estimate + cache script plan by Thu. Samir -> metric dashboard + interview templates by Fri. Zoe -> pilot addendum draft by Fri. I'll draft the DP invite email including the two tracks and fallback language. Meeting Fri 09:30 to ratify. :white_check_mark:
